name: Pointer hand
summary: White UI pointing hand with an outlined index finger and thumb; points or taps at x,y to call out something on screen.

params.name: anim
params.note: point = nudges toward the target; tap = presses with a ripple

params.name: color
params.note: ripple colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

author: krakujs
